name: Primal Squall
description: Break a squall of primal wind over the foes that stirs the dust of ages and flattens their ranks.

name: Windless Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of dead calm drawn from the eye of a great storm that no ordinary blow can enter.

name: Elder Draft
description: Bring the weight of an old and patient draft down on one foe and hold it motionless.

name: Wandering Zephyr
description: Wander a long way on a quiet zephyr and strike the foe at the end of the stroll.

name: Ancient Cyclone
description: Raise a cyclone older than the mountains and let its slow immense turning crush the field.

name: Primal Vortex
description: Open a primal vortex that takes every blow into its core and returns it as a ring of wind.

name: Timeless Flash
description: Flash through the field in a breath so brief that the foe never sees the user move.

name: Genesis Draft
description: Send the first draft of the world through the foe's frame to harm it past guard and shield.

name: First Gale
description: Call the first gale of the world upon the field and bear every foe down beneath it.

name: Elder Tempest
description: Hold an elder tempest round the user so that foes break against it and the user is unmoved.

name: Ancestral Wind
description: Summon the wind of the school's ancestors and let it sweep over the field in one long breath.

name: Worldbreaker Gale
description: Loose a gale that breaks the ground itself in a ruin that reaches the ceiling of a Core cultivator's power.

name: Primordial Exhale
description: Breathe out the wind from before the sky so the struck place returns to a time with no air until it ends.

name: Final Squall
description: Break a final squall over the foes with all the weight of a wind that has nothing left to spend.

name: Last Mantle
description: Wear the last unbroken mantle of wind that turns even the heaviest blows from the user.

name: Ending Draft
description: Press an ending draft upon one foe and still every limb as though the day had closed.

name: Closing Zephyr
description: Close the gap on a soft zephyr and strike the foe before its guard has time to rise.

name: Last Cyclone
description: Raise the last cyclone of a spent wind and drag the foes into its slow final turn.

name: Ending Vortex
description: Open a vortex that draws blows and winds into silence and then casts them back as one wave.

name: Hushed Flash
description: Flash across the field without sound or draft and strike the foe from a place it cannot hear.

name: Silencing Draft
description: Pass a silent draft through the foe's body that stills the breath past any guard.

name: Last Tempest
description: Gather the last tempest of the world and press the field flat beneath its long weight.

name: Sky Closure
description: Close the sky about the field in a ring of wind that strikes the foes and shelters the user.

name: Final Dominion
description: Hold the whole field as the last wind's dominion and sweep every foe from it.

name: Last Typhoon
description: Cast the last typhoon of the age to the ceiling of a Divine cultivator's ruin over a vast tract.

name: Wind Unmaking
description: Unmake the wind in the struck place so that no air has moved there in all its past and nothing standing can stand.

name: Eternal Breath
description: Call back a breath that has just left a fallen ally within the widest window the arts allow and rouse the chest to life.
